rca of the issue: N/A — verification-only run. The main agent's fix in 68c7774 correctly (a) removed the Fabric-incompatible @react-native-community/slider@4.5.7 import that caused silent native SIGSEGV on Android 16 + Expo SDK 54 Fabric, replacing it with a TouchableOpacity segmented control, and (b) replaced the broken `(totalScrollHeight / speedMultiplier) * 60` seconds-based formula with correct `(totalScrollHeight / pxPerSecond) * 1000` milliseconds-based formula, yielding sane wall-clock durations. Physical Android device verification remains the user's responsibility as the Fabric crash cannot be reproduced in a container test environment.
